definitions.explanation: Black ink made from soot, used in calligraphy and painting.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}の{時間|じかん}に{墨|すみ}を{摺|す}って{筆|ふで}で{書|か}いた。
examples.english: During calligraphy class, I ground ink and wrote with a brush.

notes:
{墨|すみ} is traditional East Asian ink, made from soot and used for calligraphy and painting.

TRADITIONAL USAGE:
Traditional {墨|すみ} comes in solid sticks that are ground on an inkstone ({硯|すずり}) with water. This process is called {墨|すみ}を{摺|す}る.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}: liquid ink (pre-made)
- {水墨画|すいぼくが}: ink wash painting
- {墨絵|すみえ}: ink painting
- {墨書|ぼくしょ}: writing in ink

RELATED:
- {硯|すずり}: inkstone
- {筆|ふで}: brush
- {書道|しょどう}: calligraphy
